# meraki_organization_sase_site_attachment (Data Source)

This data source can read the `Organization SASE Site Attachment` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meraki_organization_sase_site_attachment" "example" {
  id              = "12345678"
  organization_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

### Read-Only

- `network_id` (String) ID of the network to attach
- `region_slug` (String) Slug of the Secure Access region to attach the site to
- `site_id` (String) ID of the SASE site, once the attachment has completed
